title: Backend and platform engineering
responsibilities: Design and operate backend services, APIs and persistence.
Build deployment, reliability, security and developer infrastructure for general software workloads.
Classify responsibilities, not job titles; preserve explicit requirements even for adjacent roles.
exclusions: AI/ML-specific inference, retrieval, agents or model research belong to the default AI workspace unless the description also explicitly establishes general backend/platform responsibilities.
Generic AI tool use does not make a backend role an AI role.
Pure sales, product promotion and title-only records do not establish backend engineering responsibilities.
limitations: Author-defined scope and aliases, not measured prevalence or automatic keyword labeling.
First backend/platform pack only; source availability, commercial usefulness and language quality remain unverified.
Cross-domain responsibilities may overlap; no pooled worldwide market total.
